document.title: Resolve emoji images for bare and text-presentation codepoints
document.summary: `vd_emoji_cluster` now starts a cluster at Unicode's Emoji_Presentation symbols below U+1F000, and `glyph_cache_get` draws a codepoint's Twemoji image when no font has its glyph. The harness walks every image in `assets/emoji` and checks it resolves.
document.why: ✨ (U+2728) draws the missing-glyph box even though Twemoji ships its image ([#107](source:s1)).

sources.title: Emoji without a Twemoji file for the bare codepoint render as a box (e.g. U+2728 ✨)
sources.gist: ✨ renders as a box although Twemoji ships it; audit the codepoint-to-filename mapping and fall back only when no file exists.

groups.title: Emoji-presentation symbols start a cluster
groups.why: Before this, only codepoints from U+1F000 up or ones followed by U+FE0F or a keycap mark started a cluster, so ✨ never reached the image lookup ([#107](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `emoji_by_default` checks the `EMOJI_PRESENTATION` table copied from Unicode 17's emoji-data.txt, and `vd_emoji_cluster` uses it in place of the bare `first < 0x1f000` test.
lookFor: Subtle: U+FE0E right after any codepoint now returns 0 from `vd_emoji_cluster`, so `🎮︎` draws through the text path; with no font glyph it still gets the image from the fallback in the next group.

groups.title: A codepoint no font has draws its emoji image
groups.why: Text-style emoji such as © or ❤ stay text without U+FE0F; when no font has them they should still draw their Twemoji image rather than a box ([#107](source:s1)).
groups.summary: `glyph_cache_get` calls `find_emoji` with the codepoint alone when `resolve_glyph` finds no font glyph, and the harness walks every `assets/emoji` image through the same paths `text.c` uses.
lookFor: Perf: an emoji glyph returned from `glyph_cache_get` is cached in `g_emoji`, not `g_glyphs`, so each later call for that codepoint repeats `resolve_glyph` before the `find_emoji` hit.
The harness formats file names itself to match `load_emoji_image` in `src/ui/fonts.c`; a change to that format needs the same change in `emoji_file_name`.

commits.subject: fix(fonts): resolve emoji images for bare and text-presentation codepoints
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
vd_emoji_cluster only started a cluster at U+1F000 and up or before U+FE0F or a keycap mark, so emoji-presentation symbols below U+1F000 such as U+2728 never reached the image lookup and drew as the font's missing-glyph box. Treat Unicode's Emoji_Presentation set as emoji by default, keep U+FE0E as text, and let a codepoint no font has draw its Twemoji image when one exists.

The glyph cache harness now walks every image in assets/emoji and checks that its fully qualified text, and a single codepoint without U+FE0F, draws that image.

Fixes #107
